title: Pin typescript@6.0.3 exactly (dependencies) for the shared parse layer
rationale: typescript@7.x is the native port and ships no JS compiler API (no createSourceFile/SyntaxKind at runtime); the floating ^6.0.3 devDependency resolved to 7.0.2. trellis-d81d pins dependencies.typescript to exact 6.0.3. Caveat: 6.0.3 typings dropped SourceFile.parseDiagnostics and ts.computeLineStarts though the runtime still populates them — src/syntax/parse.ts uses a narrow structural carrier (never any) with tests asserting syntax errors surface, and src/syntax/sloc.ts uses the public SourceFile.getLineStarts(). Default import (import ts from "typescript") typechecks under bundler resolution and works in Bun.

title: Resolve function identity after all named scopes are registered
rationale: Duplicate class/object/function scopes must taint descendants even when the duplicate function is not a hotspot. Register ancestry from the shared AST, then resolve each body-bearing function; use direct bindings independently of display names and mark unstable scopes ambiguous.
